## Design

### 2026-11-08: For this week I want some cool project that will be a table lamp. I got inspiration from Pinterest. To make the lamp I need to make lasercut designs of the lamp panels.

**2.4h**

For this week I want some cool project that will be a table lamp. I got inspiration from Pinterest. To make the lamp I need to make lasercut designs of the lamp panels.
The lamp will be made of mdf board laser cut.
In this session I figured out how to use Inkscape to make patterns & use in fusion to make laser cutting files. I followed a tutorial to build a box in fusion 360 to practice making different faces of the lamp as new bodies/sketches.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/422dd6ae-f564-4ad7-b133-cb1a233b3413/video.mp4)

### 2026-11-08: In this session I completed the design of one panel of the lamp in Inkscape.

**1.97h**

In this session I completed the design of one panel of the lamp in Inkscape.
In inkscape pencil tool & bezier tool were used to make each circuit mappings.
I followed some designs from Pinterest to make the circuit map to the lamp's panel.
But this thing took me so much time as I had to keep in mind that design will be laser cut & I can't throw random lines in it.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/94e1f823-c8d0-4ecd-b581-5bc14f40f852/video.mp4)

### 2026-11-08: Making the lasercut files is too confusing.

**1.53h**

Making the lasercut files is too confusing.
I navigated through fusion's different options like- design, manufacture, rotate, arrange, move&copy, etc.
1. modelled lamp panels
2. arranged the panels flat so it can be lasercut.
